description: This file defines the UserPermissionsForm class for Drupal, providing an administrative form to manage user permissions, including form construction, permission grouping, and submission handling.

classes.name: UserPermissionsForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing user permissions in the admin interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing dependencies and handling deprecated argument.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles to be displayed in the form.

methods.name: permissionsByProvider
methods.description: Groups permissions by their provider module, with special handling for 'access content'.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the permissions management form with roles, permissions, and UI elements.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating role permissions and displaying a confirmation message.
